english.title: Exceed a temporary 50mph speed restriction on a motorway - manned equipment
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) drove a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), on a motorway, namely **(..SPECIFY THE MOTORWAY AND LOCATION..), subject of an Article and Order, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ARTICLE AND ORDER..), at a speed exceeding 50 miles per hour, in contravention of a temporary maximum speed restriction
english.legislation: Contrary to the above Article and Order and section 16(1) of the Road Traffic Regulation Act 1984 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
(i) Statement of facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(ii) See also H6526 for the automatic camera device version of this offence.
(iii) The summons MUST indicate the Order No. and the specific location e.g. (at, by or between marker posts No....) etc, on the special road.
(iv) A notice of intended prosecution IS required for this offence.

other.penalty:

Obligatory endorsement - licence endorsed three to six penalty points (three on a fixed penalty).

Discretionary disqualification.

Fixed penalty ticket - one hundred pounds and licence endorsed three penalty points.

Time limits on prosecutions
6 months
